```{r}
## enrollment data
big <- rn1 %>% 
  # removing REDCap stuff and address (empty)
  select(-c(2:3, rn1_address, rn1_consent_n1_tirs_complete)) %>% 
  # merge with rn2
  full_join(rn2, by = "record_id") %>% 
  # remove REDCap stuff
  select(-c(redcap_event_name, redcap_repeat_instrument))
```
